findings.fix: The lead always has at least one one-tap number in every region: intl takes the local-emergency line (tel or number), else the built-in 112 entry with 'Please check this number.'; plus one 'All urgent help' link. Tests: >=1 tel: link for 'in', for 'intl' on the trunk shape {name, tel:'112', verify:true}, and for empty Content.resources (contracts, last section).

findings.scenario: On the trunk content the Elsewhere line 'Your local emergency number' has tel '112' but shows as text with no one-tap call (urgentItem reads only x.number).
findings.fix: urgentItem reads x.number || x.tel in every list (urgent help, crisis view, lead, lock screen); a test on the trunk shape asserts tel:112 in the Elsewhere section and the intl lead.

findings.scenario: A screen-reader user: focus lands on the SOBER step title below the lead, so 'If you are not safe, call now.' and its numbers are not read.
